entries.name: ClipboardDiag

entries.name: DisplayDiag
entries.description: DISPLAYD.R4X diagnoses display discovery plus the canonical bounded multi-region present contract, external-backend and CPU-fallback capabilities, exact pixel accounting, synchronous completion, rejection without publication, and input-to-present timing.

entries.name: DriverDiag
entries.description: DRVDIAG.R4X validates Driver Work snapshot v2, the normal fair IRQ/task FIFO, isolated EDF audio lane, two workers, deadline/budget accounting, timing, wake, release, scan and cleanup telemetry; /STRESS accepts the intentional EXAMPLE lifecycle fault counters.

entries.name: FsDiag
entries.description: FSDIAG.R4X validates the R4SYS filesystem contract, FAT32 durability and metadata behavior, plus a bounded /PAGECACHE guest mode. That mode cold-reclaims clean residency before 8-KB NVMe readback and requires adaptive capacity bounds, fewer backend requests and fill-lock drops than filled 4-KB pages, raw byte/error/copy counters, safe pageable-caller publication, autonomous dirty progress, and NTFS cache-v2 repeated lookup, append/resize, rename and delete with targeted identities and no healthy-path global invalidation.

entries.name: HardwareDiag

entries.name: InputDiag

entries.name: KlickifaxLive

entries.name: LoaderDiag
entries.description: LOADERD.R4X diagnoses R4M0 loading, all six built-in Platform API groups, named Runtime-R4Ls, strict resolver/export failures and lazy R4P activation. Large R4X and relocation-heavy R4P workloads enforce substantially fewer physical range reads through the fixed 8 KiB metadata reader; exact early records remain mandatory unless the bounded boot log explicitly reports rollover.

entries.name: NetIoDiag

entries.name: NetworkFacadeCDiag

entries.name: NtfsDiag

All modes preserve raw counters, tail distributions, checks, and versioned NDJSON v7 results.

entries.name: Build-NecDspFirmware.ps1

entries.name: nec_dsp_firmware_harness.zig
entries.description: Validates and executes all six generated DSP revision images through the generic production core, covers four instruction classes, 16 ALUs, 16 sources, 16 destinations and 39+1 branches and binds aggregate state FNV-1a B281EE2EAAA5F878. The optional private gate validates known user-firmware hashes in place, boots all six DSP plus ST010/ST011 revision paths and checks DSP-1B Q15 multiplication without emitting protected bytes or tables.

entries.name: st018_test.zig
entries.description: Exercises all 4096 compact ARMv3 decoder keys plus canonical PSR transfer, every condition, banked CPU mode, pipeline/prefetch, ALU and barrel shifts, short/long multiply, single/block transfer, swap, branches, software/undefined/abort/IRQ exceptions and exact memory phases. It drives the production ST018 128-KiB program ROM, 32-KiB data ROM, 16-KiB work RAM, host mirrors/handshake, timer, fixed reset delay, firmware policy, dirty bounds, arbitrary slices, cartridge bus and multi-instance cleanup.

entries.name: Build-St018Firmware.ps1

entries.name: st018_firmware_harness.zig
entries.description: Validates the generated 163840-byte firmware and two independent source pins, executes reset delay, bidirectional host handshake and work-RAM writes through the production ARMv3/ST018 core and binds exact state digest DE7069060A5E262D. entries.name: enhancement_test.zig
entries.description: Drives OBC-1, S-RTC, S-DD1 and SPC7110/Epson-RTC through production cartridge and bus paths. Covers exact RAM/mirrors, dirty bounds, board profiles and revisions; all S-DD1 bitplane/context modes, DMA shadow activation, transfer end, bank windows, reset and arbitrary slices; all SPC7110 1/2/4-bpp DCU modes, PROM/DROM mapping, data-port seek/stride, arithmetic including division by zero, SRAM gate, reset/open bus; and Epson BCD/status/index/write, stop/reset, leap/year-wrap and invalid-write behavior.

entries.name: enhancement_reference_cases.json
entries.description: Binds four original synthetic S-DD1 bitplane/context streams and three SPC7110 1/2/4-bpp streams to a seven-record SHA-256 trace that was generated byte-identically by the unmodified Mesen2 and Snes9x decompressor sources; Ares is retained as a third source-reviewed state-machine oracle and no commercial ROM bytes are present.

entries.name: persistence_test.zig
entries.description: Tests exact normalized-hash SAV/RTC paths, SRAM versus SA-1 BW-RAM policy, zero backend access for battery-less boards, exact board-sized load/restart, OBC-1 selector/object reconstruction, battery-backed Super-FX internal write-buffer persistence, atomic SA-1 BW-RAM restart without I-RAM leakage, exact 4096-byte ST010 data-RAM restart into the uPD96050 owner and exact 16384-byte ST018 work-RAM restart before ARM execution; delayed flush, one-writer contention, lost write acknowledgements with dirty-state retention and release-on-close; versioned checksummed S-RTC/Epson records, live/latch/halt/overflow state, forward-only bounded time applied once across close/restart, chip mismatch and checksum-valid semantic corruption.

entries.name: cpu_test.zig
entries.description: Instantiates all 256 legal W65C816 opcodes in emulation plus four native M/X variants and tests exact BCD, direct-page quirks and penalties, bank-crossing word/RMW order, block moves, RESET/ABORT/NMI/IRQ/WAI/STP transitions, stack/vector traces, deterministic isolation and first-micro-operation divergence diagnostics.

entries.name: system_test.zig
entries.description: Tests bounded and partition-invariant integer NTSC/PAL clocks plus the rational S-SMP oscillator, pause and frame geometry; 5A22 WRAM ports, MEMSEL/FastROM, H/V latches, masked internal open bus, multiplier/divider, 40-clock DRAM refresh and NMI/IRQ edges; exact keyboard, focus, opposite-direction, serial and disconnected-port behavior; auto-joypad timing; production CPU execution across host groupings; DMA confinement, 21FF wrap, WRAM conflict, refresh and NMI continuity; and PPU/APU observation of the same canonical master-clock timeline.

entries.name: smp_test.zig
entries.description: Tests the complete SPC700 dispatch through explicit bus phases; separate ordered and oscillator-timestamped CPU/SMP port latches; all three divider timers and clear-on-read output; semantic IPL upload with collision-free non-sequential block/launch commands and deferred pairing of both writes from a 16-bit S-CPU STA $2140; exact 64-byte private firmware validation/execution; missing and invalid firmware rejection; SLEEP/STOP bounded low-power cycles; and oscillator progress invariance across host slices and zero-progress waits.

entries.name: sdsp_test.zig
entries.description: Executes nine exact SNES-SPC differential cases for BRR impulse/filter/loop, eight voices, Gaussian pitch/modulation, noise, KON/KOFF/readbacks, ADSR/all GAIN modes and echo/FIR; verifies real SPC700 F2/F3 register access, partition-invariant 32-to-48-kHz conversion, 2048-frame caller blocks, bounded overflow/underflow, prefill, mute/backend degradation, reset and idempotent close through r4os.subsystem_runtime without coupling guest progress to audio.

entries.name: sdsp_reference_cases.json
entries.description: Binds nine native stereo PCM, ENDX/ENVX/OUTX and echo-RAM FNV-1a expectations to independent SNES-SPC revision ec8ee2bbe30451614c1d02a83f7af1c97d497d45 without redistributing oracle code.

entries.name: Analyze-SdspWav.ps1
entries.description: Parses 48-kHz stereo PCM S16LE WAV captures and checks signal density, maximum gap, frequency, channel polarity and RMS ratio; its automatic self-test accepts the nominal fixture and rejects a missing 10-ms quantum, wrong frequency and wrong channel balance.

entries.name: dma_test.zig
entries.description: Tests all eight DMA modes, directions, fixed/increment/decrement addresses, zero-size continuation, channel priority and exact clocks; direct/indirect HDMA initialization, transfer, repeat, skip, reload, completion and restart; byte-boundary preemption, live DMAP writes, arbitrary service partitions, bounded trace diagnostics and explicit S-CPU revision classifications.

entries.name: dma_reference_cases.json
entries.description: Binds four synthetic DMA/HDMA model oracles and three digest-pinned current/historical Undisbeliever ROM diagnostics with bounded timeouts, first-bus-divergence fields and an explicit zero-enabled-gates policy for visual or revision-uncertain cases.

entries.name: ppu_test.zig
entries.description: Tests exact VRAM increment/remapping/prefetch and active-display blocking, CGRAM/OAM latches, modes 0-6 planar rendering and Mode-7 matrix/EXTBG, all 256/512 x 224/239/448/478 geometries, Pseudo-Hires, windows, fixed color math, mosaic and mid-scanline writes with twelve fixed XRGB32 digests, sprite limits, copied generation independence, bounded damage and unchanged-frame suppression.

entries.name: video_host_test.zig
entries.description: Tests generation-safe native XRGB32 binding, full and damage presentation, all geometry transitions, resize/letterbox point rejection, at-most-128x128 raster blocks, unchanged suppression, pause delivery, reset-style rebind, stale-generation rejection and idempotent close through r4os.subsystem_host.

entries.name: product_host_test.zig
entries.description: Interleaves two private productive SNES guests and verifies isolated CPU/bus/PPU/S-SMP state, focused physical keypad input with release and disconnected port 2, a defined WRAM completion witness, native XRGB32 generations, audio degradation recovery, productive clocks and frames, pause/resume, fresh reset generations and peer-independent close. It drains 60 seconds of NTSC host debt partition-invariantly through grants no larger than 32768 masterclocks, rejects a second battery writer, preserves exact SAV across reset, releases every resource once after injected persistence failure and frees invalid owned sources before persistence opens.

entries.name: fixture_rom_test.zig
entries.description: Builds deterministic original .sfc/.smc cartridges without commercial or proprietary bytes, validates their header, battery/RTC and missing-firmware classes, then runs the productive W65C816, semantic IPL upload, SPC700/S-DSP tone, controller witness, PPU frame and battery write paths.

entries.name: performance_harness.zig
entries.description: Profiles one exact NTSC master-clock second independently through the raw clock, 5A22 owner and PPU, then executes the original product cartridge for five guest seconds in ReleaseFast. It reports wall time, masterclocks per second, bounded slice count, beam/PPU frames, W65C816 instructions/cycles, S-SMP clocks and observable WRAM/CGRAM state so product-host regressions can be attributed without treating host speed as correctness truth.

entries.name: cartridge_probe.zig
entries.description: Runs one explicitly supplied local .sfc/.smc through the production cartridge parser and complete Machine for a bounded 1-300 guest seconds, optionally with an exact user-supplied 64-byte IPL. It drains PCM and reports per-second CPU, PPU, semantic-IPL, SPC700 and S-DSP telemetry plus visible-pixel and nonzero-audio counts without copying, embedding or emitting cartridge or firmware bytes; it is a diagnostic and not a public-ROM gate.

entries.name: maturity_harness.zig
entries.description: Executes an original product cartridge eleven times in ReleaseSafe across NTSC/PAL, 1-ms/17-ms/irregular host pacing, 4096/32768-masterclock partitions, a regressed timestamp, cold restart and distinct instance IDs. It binds canonical machine and every streamed PCM byte to region-specific SHA-256, rejects debt, drift, audio loss, port-2 connection and non-idempotent close, and runs in the normal owner gate.

entries.name: ppu_reference_cases.json
entries.description: Binds twelve exact synthetic mode-0-through-7, Mode-7 EXTBG, window/color-math and mosaic XRGB32 owner digests plus 23 SHA-256-pinned VMAIN, effect, example, hardware and HDRV diagnostics with bounded timeouts and first-divergence records; no visual ROM is promoted without a licensed hardware oracle.

entries.name: hdrv_geometry_cases.json
entries.description: Defines nine deterministic HDRV-derived BGMODE/SETINI scripts covering native 256/512 by 224/239/448/478 and Pseudo-Hires geometry without relying on subjective visual or audio observations.

entries.name: cpu_coverage.zig
entries.description: Generates the schema-1 W65C816 opcode/addressing/width coverage index with all 256 legal bytes and five tested decode variants per byte into the R4SNES artifact prefix.

entries.name: reference_manifest.json
entries.description: Binds the R4SNES reference harness to exact References.json, 0.73.25 qualification-matrix, DMA-case, PPU-case, HDRV-script, S-DSP-case and enhancement-case SHA-256 digests plus the expected 16 repositories, five downloads, nine trees, 147 ROMs including six SA-1 hardware ROMs, four CX4 programs, six open NEC-DSP firmwares with 122 matrix words, two ST01x profiles, one ARMv3/ST018 image, the original four-cartridge installed-product E2E contract, the eleven-run NTSC/PAL maturity contract, public semantic-IPL correction and accurately scoped Lenovo result.

entries.name: reference_harness.zig
entries.description: Optionally validates the pinned SNES reference and 0.73.25 qualification matrix including implemented OBC-1/S-RTC/S-DD1/SPC7110/Super-FX/SA-1/CX4/NEC-DSP/ST010/ST011/ST018 status, the installed-product E2E and maturity policies, semantic-IPL correction and accurately separated Lenovo passes, accepted limit and discarded observations, plus DMA, PPU, HDRV, nine-case SNES-SPC, seven-case decompression, six-program GSU, four-program CX4, six open DSP-firmware, two ST01x-profile and one ARMv3/ST018 evidence set. It reproduces every enhancement byte, verifies exact independent-source pins and executed oracles; executes nine native geometry scripts; normalizes all 147 licensed test cartridges; runs unchanged Gilyon CPU/SPC and all 256000 SPC700 state/bus records. Missing ExFiles material is a documented SKIP.

entries.name: work_gate.zig

entries.name: controller_policy.zig

entries.name: controller_reset.zig
entries.description: Models HDA quiesce, CRST low/hold/high and delayed STATESTS from a firmware-initialized state and verifies monotone timeout failure at every blocked phase.

entries.name: command_ring.zig

entries.name: codec_program.zig
entries.description: Checks analog Pin Config Default ranking, jack fallback, 48-kHz stereo S16 capability rejection, capability-derived 0-dB amps and exact bounded D0/format/selector/mixer/EAPD/stream verb plans.

entries.name: stream_hardware.zig
entries.description: Checks bounded Output/bidirectional GCAP descriptor selection, aligned address-width-safe DMA position layout, DMA/LPIB plausibility and fallback, distinct active/transient/fallback diagnostic modes, ring wrap, movement-based freeze detection and impossible-jump rejection.

entries.name: irq_recovery.zig

entries.description: Injects failure after every HDA ownership stage, requires exact reverse and repeat-idempotent cleanup, proves a fresh unload/reload ownership generation without retained PCM, checks dynamic work reacquisition, and requires forced stale-PCM removal before drain timeout or hardware failure is reported.

entries.name: pattern.zig

entries.description: Starts the Test image with QEMU WAV audio on Windows or Debian Linux for the one- or four-vCPU acceptance, waits for AUDIOD and both 60-second productive R4GB instances including drained asynchronous saves, then applies the independent AudioDiag and lifecycle-aware R4GB continuity analyzers to the same hardware-path recording.

entries.name: mixer.zig

entries.name: session_ownership.zig

entries.name: performance_test.zig
entries.description: R4BASIC hotpath component tests for 262144-operation adaptive timed slices, bounded clock calls, lazy post-instruction display creation, immediate same-slice visibility for consumed sequence-tagged console input, the fallback wake deadline for other cadence-deferred echoes, and ordered accepted/dropped input retained across pause/resume, plus exact typed arrays, atomic resize caps, string ownership, borrowed built-ins, reusable lazy locals, numeric formatting and retained VAL scratch storage.

entries.name: Test-QemuPerformanceMarker.ps1
entries.description: Validates the six interactive R4BASIC /PERFTEST workload markers and exact summary for numeric, 4-KB assignment, LEN, UCASE$, procedure-call and array throughput, the 262144-operation/20-clock bounds, no fixed sleep, one assignment clone, borrowed read-only built-ins and reusable lazy-local frame pools.

entries.name: physical_key.zig
entries.description: Tests Set-1 to USB-HID usage conversion, left/right modifier identity, exact keypad identity separate from navigation and Num Lock, ordered make/break/repeat transitions with post-transition modifier snapshots, duplicate suppression and overflow collapse to one fail-safe reset.

entries.name: unit_test.zig
entries.description: Tests independently analyzable DMG owners and profiles; deterministic generation and validation of original ROM-only, dual-mode MBC3 battery/RTC and CGB-only product fixtures; complete immutable cartridge parsing, full-ROM SHA-256 identity, all supported mapper models and exact capability rejections; bounded 64-KiB bus access; complete SM83, timer, interrupt, DMA, serial and joypad behavior; dot-clocked PPU and changed-frame publication; all four APU channels and exact 48-kHz PCM; slice partition invariance; and deterministic isolation across Machine instances.

entries.name: persistence_test.zig
entries.description: Injects a deterministic storage backend to verify full-ROM hash identity, exact raw battery SRAM, versioned checksummed MBC3 RTC records, missing/corrupt/restart policy, bounded backward and forward wall-clock jumps, two-second dirty delay, mandatory clean Close, atomic failure and full-disk preservation, non-battery silence, exclusive writers, stale-generation protection, idempotent cleanup, RTC tick/latch/halt/day-overflow behavior, MMM01 locking and digital HuC1 behavior.

entries.description: Machine-readable DMG-CPU-C qualification matrix covering 15 executed case sets from six pinned open-source families. It records licenses, revisions, hashes, selectors, completion protocols, timeouts and targets, requires every applicable DMG case, forbids title-specific exceptions, and documents ten CGB/SGB/AGB/peripheral or manual-only exclusions.

entries.description: Deterministically executes all 500000 pinned SM83 SingleStep cases through the production decoder and compares registers, flags, PC, SP, IME, changed RAM and every M-cycle bus event. It verifies every suite's expected digest, fingerprints 227 licensed open ROMs, executes 28 Mooneye mapper images through the production Machine, runs three CPU-only probes, 34 revision-applicable DMG-C clock/I/O ROMs, 32 DMG-C PPU ROMs and three DMG-applicable SameSuite ROMs, compares 25 DMG Acid2/Mealybug runs pixel-exactly against revision-bound PNG references, drives all three RTC3Test groups through the emulated UI and executes the generated Mealybug MBC3-RTC ROM. The complete manifest reports 15 suites, 852 files and 500129 vectors or result records. Missing optional suites are SKIP and commercial ROMs remain excluded.

entries.name: ppu_screenshots_0725.json

entries.description: Revision-pinned DMG-C SameSuite selection containing the two applicable DIV-write/NR52 APU trigger ROMs plus the EI-delay/HALT interrupt case; CGB- and SGB-specific cases are outside the target.

entries.name: video_host_test.zig
entries.description: Checks the private native 160x144 Indexed8 PPU surface, exact four-shade palette, bounded subsystem_host raster blocks, full/damage/unchanged and resize behavior, letterbox exclusion, complete-frame publication, pause, LCD shutdown, generation-safe reset and idempotent close.

entries.name: runtime_adapter_test.zig
entries.description: Runs the DMG machine through r4os.subsystem_runtime with caller-owned PCM queues, proves exact finite 6000-frame drain and that a completion witness becomes source-finished only after all accumulated guest-clock debt is executed, then injects an audio write failure while CPU, timer, PPU and input continue without further backend calls before an idempotent Close.

entries.name: product_host_test.zig
entries.description: Interleaves private productive DMG guests for different ROMs and a permitted byte-identical same-ROM non-battery launch, and verifies isolated memory/input/pacing, 32768-T-cycle slice bounds, pause-corrected time, focus release, a defined guest completion witness, fresh reset machine/video/PCM generations, peer-independent Close, battery-RAM transfer, exact invalid/CGB-only/accessory rejection cleanup and idempotent teardown even when final persistence fails.

entries.name: maturity_harness.zig
entries.description: Profiles one guest second independently through the SM83, PPU and APU owners, then runs the original battery/RTC E2E fixture for two guest seconds at 1-ms and 17-ms host pacing. It requires bounded completion, exact complete Machine-state and PCM parity, emits a final video/audio digest, and enforces a generous responsiveness ceiling without replacing correctness with a benchmark.

entries.name: Analyze-QemuApuWav.ps1
entries.description: Parses regular or streaming stereo PCM S16 QEMU WAV output, identifies R4GB by its deliberate 2:1 NR50 mix, validates the long approximately 440-Hz signal against a duration tolerance, accepts exactly one bounded early lifecycle-reset gap, and rejects a missing mid-signal audio quantum in its self-test.

entries.name: cartridge_probe.zig
entries.description: Validates one explicitly supplied local complete cartridge through the production parser and mapper initializer, hashes the input before and after, and reports title, DMG capability, mapper, ROM/RAM, battery and RTC properties without embedding or distributing the image.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode Verify
entries.description: Checks the frozen Recovery source/runtime inventory, SHA-256 integrity, original source archives, actual R4M0 imports/exports against manifests and the pinned platform contract, transitive runtime-library imports and protocol-role dependencies. Both thin host starters use this shared local-only entrypoint; this static check does not claim guest runtime compatibility.
entries.notes: 0.76.1: Owner builds and canonical container checks; isolated-path and negative dependency/integrity checks passed on Linux/PowerShell 7. Windows execution not tested.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode BootTest
entries.description: Builds the independent Recovery diagnostic kernel and one-FAT32/no-SYSTEM boot fixture from pinned sources; runs bounded Limine BIOS/x64-UEFI QEMU guests with four vCPUs. Requires four CPU-bound heap/wait workers, unchanged reserved boot payload, no crash and regular poweroff or reset. Production kernels omit the diagnostic witness.
entries.notes: 0.76.2: BIOS and UEFI passed both poweroff and reboot on Linux/KVM with SMP4 and 1024 MB RAM. Serial logs and hashes in Artifacts/BootProbe; Windows execution not tested.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode RuntimeTest
entries.description: Uses the shared SMP4 BIOS/UEFI Recovery boot runner with a complete FAT32 RAM volume. Removes the USB boot device and both QEMU backends before userland admission, then checks frozen R4L/R4D/R4P/R4X loading, late media hash, Terminal child output, RAM write/read/delete and program cleanup. Rejects missing, truncated, corrupt and duplicate boot volumes. Test-Boot.ps1 -Action terminal additionally exercises the regular interactive Terminal kernel with HELP and POWEROFF after USB removal.
entries.notes: 0.76.3: Linux/KVM, four vCPUs, 1024 MB RAM: BIOS/UEFI late RAM access and production Terminal keyboard/poweroff passed after USB removal; four invalid-image cases rejected before mounting. One earlier OVMF pre-kernel USB boot failure is recorded in Problems.txt; identical image passed standalone and paired reruns. Windows execution not tested.

entries.name: Build.bat
entries.description: Workspace acceptance entrypoint that omits Klickifax and KlickifaxLive from regular profiles, restores them only for explicitly requested browser runs, includes R4BASIC in Test for the canonical first-frame baseline, creates requested images, keeps benchmark execution separate, uses the four-CPU headless marker contract for regular guest acceptance, and exposes a short CLOCKPROBE-terminated SMP4 smoke that does not start Userland, R4GB or R4SNES.

entries.name: Build.sh storage-test
entries.description: Bounded owner tests for GUID byte order, both GPT copies and CRCs, overlaps/cloned IDs, MBR bounds, strict installation JSON, CURRENT/PREVIOUS identity and local/USB target rules. Shared step is also in the full Kernel test step. Also covers bounded device/mount/use/claim state: region conflicts, required RAM protection, stale references, owner/range checks, drain-before-release, registration retirement and generation exhaustion.
entries.notes: 0.76.4: Linux host checks passed; Recovery SMP4 integration provides actual Limine and device coverage.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode StorageTest
entries.description: Builds fixed five-partition GPT fixtures and runs bounded SMP4 BIOS/UEFI USB/AHCI, NVMe/PREVIOUS and cloned-ID/invalid-manifest cases. Two USB plus AHCI/NVMe media, six simultaneous NTFS volumes, per-volume file access, unknown filesystem, real boot identity, stable C:/R: and media/target filtering. Uses QEMU snapshots and file images only.
entries.notes: 0.76.4: Linux/KVM: all seven SMP4 cases passed, including read/write/flush/delete on six simultaneously mounted NTFS volumes; normal R4OS SMP4 testquick passed. No Windows or hardware run.

entries.name: Build.sh input-test
entries.description: Groups existing bounded i8042, codepoint queue, keyboard layout, HID Set-1, USB host and xHCI event-router owner tests. The full Kernel test step depends on this group without running its individual tests twice.
entries.notes: 0.76.5: Linux owner group passed; no new individual test suite or hardware claim.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode InputTest
entries.description: Eight SMP4 cases combine BIOS/UEFI, USB/local boot and PS/2/USB keyboards. USB-only cases disable i8042; an attached USB mouse remains unbound. Positive guest readiness gates QMP key injection for navigation, EN/DE layouts, modifiers and Unicode codepoints, followed by actual Terminal typing, Backspace correction, redirected file verification and EXIT. Local USB-storage exclusion must preserve USB-HID input.
entries.notes: 0.76.5: all eight Linux/KVM SMP4 cases passed. Shared owner input-test and normal Kernel build passed. Fixed premature test injection on empty PowerShell log output; Terminal witness follows its existing uppercase behavior. No Windows or physical keyboard acceptance.

entries.name: zig build view-test
entries.description: Checks the Recovery artwork/monitor geometry at several framebuffer sizes and clipping of fill/glyph operations with unchanged neighboring pixels; bounded console transcript wrapping, scrolling, backspace and clear with buffer canaries.
entries.notes: 0.76.6: Linux host geometry/clipping/transcript checks passed. Actual framebuffer and independent-console proof is grouped in UITest; no duplicate guest suite.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode UITest
entries.description: SMP4 BIOS at 800x600, 1024x768 and 1920x1080 plus UEFI at 1024x768. Hardware USB keys navigate six visible menu rows and dialogs, type into the unchanged Terminal, clear, scroll, EXIT and restart. A second Terminal transcript must remain unchanged and be reaped. P6 framebuffer assertions compare all pixels outside the monitor against the original BMP and subsequent states.
entries.notes: 0.76.6: all four Linux/KVM SMP4 cases passed, 64 framebuffer comparisons, independent Terminal preserved and reaped, regular reset. Original 4720110-byte BMP exercises the corrected canonical FAT32 full-file path beyond 4096 clusters. Normal R4OS SMP4 testquick passed. Windows and physical hardware not tested.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode NetworkTest
entries.description: Bounded SMP4 BIOS/VirtioNet and UEFI/RTL8139 production boots exercise host OpenSSH shell/exec/SFTP/SCP and active/passive FTP. Hashes cover offline FAT32/NTFS create/read/copy/replace/rename/delete; RAM system targets stay protected and offline R4X starts are rejected. Full menu framebuffer stays byte-equal during remote work. A no-NIC case corrupts SYSTEM boot sectors in the disposable fixture, exercises local Terminal and resets.
entries.notes: 0.76.7: three Linux/KVM cases passed; host runner fixes cover duplicate executable discovery, OpenSSH batch password option order and PowerShell array arithmetic. Contract bindings and normal SMP4 testquick passed. Original upload publication remains create-only; replacement is SSH-COPY or explicit delete/upload. No new hardware/manual acceptance and no change to the normal offline headless runner.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode StorageAccessTest
entries.description: Extends the shared SMP4 BIOS/UEFI network acceptance with public storage inventory, raw bounds, local stream/volume uses, real held SFTP file/directory handles, paused FTP upload, abrupt SSH disconnect, concurrent exclusive access/foreign owner denial, abandoned-claim cleanup, stale mount/table references, remount failure/repair and an actual QEMU blkdebug NVMe flush failure. Unrelated DATA/RAM and the menu remain usable.
entries.notes: 0.76.8: focused guest acceptance; requires native OpenSSH and the existing QEMU host profile. No manual hardware acceptance.

entries.name: CheckStorageTools0769.zig
entries.description: Grouped common GPT/MBR/FAT32/NTFS fixtures: table identity/geometry, free ranges, overlap and unsupported conversion rejection; stale/read races; partial write, flush, verification and cancellation; quick/full, 128-GB NTFS with a 2-MB allocator, and every preparation allocation failure.
entries.notes: 0.76.9: SDK storage-tools-test; existing ImageCreator/NtfsVerify fixtures remain the independent small-volume structural checks.

entries.name: Build.ps1 -Mode StorageToolsTest
entries.description: Extends the existing SMP4 BIOS/UEFI network runner with a disposable 128-MB NVMe disk: same SDK MBR/GPT/CLEAN routines, FAT32 quick and NTFS full under physical claims, fresh partition inventory, actual mounts, file reads/writes and unmount flush. Existing remote repairs and unchanged menu remain checked.
entries.notes: 0.76.9: only the technical fixture GUID and matching blank scratch disk admit the hidden diagnostic. No manual hardware test.
